claims.claim: Existing equal, fast-forward, FAILURE and reviewed-PASS synchronization paths retain their locked mutation and safe-restart boundaries.

H1R validates complete bound RESULT/EVIDENCE, byte-exact REVIEW and applicable lineage before accepting CHANGES_REQUIRED or BLOCKED solely as preservation proof, retaining verdicts, findings and remote refs.

Malformed-artifact fixtures now inject invalid bytes into otherwise valid parentless artifact trees and assert precise parser rejection. Identity, lineage, substitution, conflicting-proof and unpreserved-ancestry rejection gates remain intact.
Repository safety and mutation-edge reproof remain enforced before the single exact-target reset, with clean attached-main postconditions and safe generation restart.

Preserved synthetic E2E regressions exercise existing workflow, transient-control, H1R and admission bindings, including bounded private-data-free pre-RUN refusal with run_created=false, executor_invoked=false and no fabricated correction records.
Terminal dispatch regressions retain nonexecuting replay and unchanged original journals; independent-checkout journal absence remains unknown without migration or AIOS_REPO_ROOT changes.
The existing normative self-host flow documents proof eligibility, typed refusals, journal locality and separate Reviewer, correction and Publisher authority.
